meta.title: PR Approval: step 2 not bypassed when "vendor pre-approved" does not hold
gaps: Create or submit a purchase requisition for INR 10,000 with vendor pre-approved set to false.
Configure or trigger the PR approval bypass condition so only the vendor pre-approved predicate is false.
Verify that step 2 is required and routed to the Requestor's Line Manager, including the existence of a pending step-2 approval for that person.
Sign in as or otherwise access the Requestor's Line Manager's approval task.
